title: System4Dispatch layout
description: A complete panel: grid size, blocks, turnouts and the tiles drawn.

elements.description: Tiles drawn on the grid, at most one per cell.

name.description: Human-readable layout name, shown in the app's title bar.

version.description: Format version. Files newer than the app understands are refused.

Block.description:
A detection block. Occupancy detectors usually produce one event when the
block becomes occupied and another when it clears.

clear_event.description: Event produced when the block becomes clear.

id.description: Unique id (shared namespace with turnouts), e.g. `"B1"`.

name.description: Display name; the id is shown when empty.

occupied_event.description: Event produced when the block becomes occupied.

oneOf.description: A track tile. `"type": "turnout"` is accepted as a legacy alias.

block.description: The block this tile belongs to, by id.

block2.description:
The block of the second track through a crossing tile
([`Shape::has_two_tracks`]): the track that doesn't start at the
tile's W edge. `None` means the same block as `block`.

portal.description:
The name of a [`Shape::Portal`]'s link: the track continues at
the other portal with the same name.

turnout.description: The turnout this tile shows, by id (turnout shapes only).

turnout2.description:
The second turnout of a switch worked by two
([`Shape::has_two_turnouts`]): the right-hand points of a 3-way
switch or slip. `turnout` is the left-hand one. See
[`Shape::routes`] for what each combination sets.

turntable.description: The turntable this tile shows, by id ([`Shape::Turntable`] only).

EventId.description: An OpenLCB event ID: eight hex bytes, optionally separated by '.', ':', '-' or ' '.

Feedback.description: Events produced by a turnout's position sensors.

normal_event.description: Produced when the points reach normal.

reverse_event.description: Produced when the points reach reverse.

Grid.description: The size of the tile grid, in cells.

Shape.description: Tile shapes. Each can be rotated in 45° steps (`rot` 0..=7, clockwise).

oneOf.description:
W to NE (a 45° curve). `"tight_curve"`, a 90° bend in some
development builds, is read as this.

Three routes from W: left to NE, straight to E, right to SE. Thrown
by two turnouts: `turnout` reversed takes the left route, `turnout2`
reversed the right route, both normal the straight route.

A diamond crossing (W–E and NW–SE) with one slip road, W–SE. Worked
by two turnouts; see [`Shape::routes`].

A diamond crossing (W–E and NW–SE) with both slip roads, W–SE and
NW–E. Worked by two turnouts; see [`Shape::routes`].

A turntable pit, with its roundhouse. Its tracks come from the
[`Turntable`], not from the tile's rotation.

A track from W that leaves here and carries on at the other portal
with the same name, like a tunnel that wraps from one edge of the
panel to the other.

Turnout.description:
A turnout. Sending `normal_event` / `reverse_event` throws it; optional
feedback events report the real point position.

feedback.description: Point-position feedback, if the turnout has sensors.

id.description: Unique id (shared namespace with blocks), e.g. `"T1"`.

linked.description: Id of a turnout always thrown together with this one (e.g. the other half of a crossover). Both turnouts must name each other and agree on `linked_inverted`.

linked_inverted.description: Throw the linked turnout to the opposite position instead.

name.description: Display name; the id is shown when empty.

normal_event.description: Event that throws the turnout to normal.

reverse_event.description: Event that throws the turnout to reverse.

Turntable.description:
A turntable and its roundhouse: a pit drawn centred on a
[`Shape::Turntable`] tile, with tracks radiating from it at any angle.
Lead tracks join the rest of the panel; stalls are drawn inside an engine
house around the pit.

Like a turnout, it is driven by two events: `cw_event` turns the bridge
to the next track clockwise and `ccw_event` to the next one
counter-clockwise. A track's optional `feedback_event` reports that the
bridge has lined up with it.

ccw_event.description: Event that turns the bridge to the next track counter-clockwise.

cw_event.description: Event that turns the bridge to the next track clockwise.

id.description: Unique id (shared namespace with blocks and turnouts), e.g. `"TT1"`.

name.description: Display name; the id is shown when empty.

size.description: Pit diameter in grid cells, at least 1.

tracks.description:
The tracks around the pit, in clockwise order from north (see
[`Turntable::sort_tracks`]). The bridge stops at each in turn.

TurntableTrack.description: A track leaving a turntable pit.

angle.description:
Direction from the pit's centre, in whole degrees clockwise from
north (`0..360`), on the drawing as shown. Leads should use multiples
of 45 so they meet the grid's track.

feedback_event.description: Event produced when the bridge lines up with this track (optional).

name.description: Display name, e.g. `"Stall 3"`; may be empty.

stall.description: A roundhouse stall (drawn inside the engine house) rather than a lead.
